strategy_lineage: matched-comparator audit of S-IWD-PROD-SP500-ROLE from ATM-SVP2-US-VALUE-PROD-001; frozen nfci-dual-core-v11 target/event path
hypothesis: After eliminating the post-result comparator mismatch between the frozen V11 S&P 500 price-index role and IWD adjusted-close total-return proxy, the IWD value-role implementation still improves the same production target/event path relative to a matched SPY adjusted-close total-return control. A pass is required before the IWD result may be interpreted as value-role improvement rather than dividend/total-return measurement advantage.

audit_motivation.methodological_issue: the frozen V11 sp500 fixture is an S&P 500 price-index series while IWD was evaluated with Yahoo adjusted close, which is a total-return proxy; the observed improvement could therefore mix value exposure with dividend-reinvestment measurement
audit_motivation.correction_policy: do not rewrite or delete the prior PASS; add this stricter result-informed formal audit and require it for any V12 product/value-role interpretation

allowed_changes: introduce one fixed matched control C-SPY-TR-PROD-SP500-ROLE using SPY Yahoo adjusted-close total-return proxy on the exact frozen V11 sp500 portfolio role
evaluate one fixed candidate S-IWD-VS-SPY-TR-ROLE using IWD Yahoo adjusted-close total-return proxy on the same role

use 2000-05-30 as the common substitution/evaluation start because IWD first quotes on 2000-05-26 and its second quote on 2000-05-30 is the first date with a defined IWD close-to-close return; SPY is already available
before 2000-05-30 both paths use the original frozen S&P price-index role and are identical to V11
on union-calendar dates with no new IWD/SPY quote, carry the last adjusted close forward so that day's matched role return is zero and the next quote realizes the full close-to-close return
retain frozen V11 signals, target weights, execution events, 100% gross limit, no-financing policy, fees, slippage, and cash model unchanged
selection_metric: No model selection. Compare the single IWD candidate only with the fixed SPY matched-total-return control. The original V11 price-index path is reported for background/identity only and is not the primary admission comparator.
pass_fail_gates: deterministic 2000-05-30+: IWD candidate CAGR > SPY matched-control CAGR
deterministic 2000-05-30+: IWD candidate Sharpe >= SPY matched-control Sharpe
deterministic: at least 5/7 fixed folds candidate Sharpe >= SPY matched-control Sharpe in the same fold

deterministic: source production V11 full target fingerprint exactly equals ba67c8aa24bc7168; SPY control and IWD candidate execution-event target fingerprints exactly equal the source execution-event target fingerprint; target gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or shorting
bootstrap on 2000-05-30+ common behavior: paired circular moving blocks IWD versus SPY, 63 sessions, 20000 replicates, seed 20260822
PBO: not applicable because there is one fixed candidate and one non-selectable matched control
global post-protocol DSR probability >=95% using the prior 40 performance-bearing formal candidates plus this IWD matched-comparator candidate, total 41
ROBUST_MATCHED_ROLE_PASS requires every applicable deterministic, bootstrap, and global DSR gate
follow_up_policy: This is a methodology-correction audit, not a rescue search. After formal performance is opened, do not change SPY, IWD, adjusted-close price field, 2000-05-30 start, substitution fraction, calendar alignment, folds, thresholds, fees, target path, or add any third comparator. If the audit fails, ATM-SVP2-US-VALUE-PROD-001 remains a truthful historical PASS under its original preregistration but its value-premium/product-upgrade interpretation is downgraded; the IWD V12 prospective/product promotion must be suspended rather than rescued. If the audit passes, the exact IWD rule remains frozen and its existing prospective clock may continue without historical retuning.
